stepsSection.title: From search to keys, in three steps
stepsSection.description: No middleman in any of them — and nothing to pay us along the way.

steps.title: Search your locality
steps.description: Filter by area, budget, furnishing and possession. Every result is an owner listing.

steps.title: Call the owner directly
steps.description: The number on the listing belongs to the owner. Ask your questions, fix a visit time.

steps.title: Close it and get the papers done
steps.description: Agreement, registration, loan and shifting — add them only if you need them.

stepsSection.ctaSubtitle: Browsing needs no sign-up. 3,140 owners listed a property this month.

testimonials.quote: Three brokers wanted a month's rent each for the same flat in Baner. Here I called the owner on Sunday and moved in on Thursday.
I live in New Jersey and my plot near Dholera needed papers checked. The NRI desk sent me the 7/12 and a site video the same week.
Listed my Rajkot house on a Tuesday. Nine calls by Friday, and not one of them was a broker fishing for a listing.

appDownload.title: Get alerts the minute something opens up nearby
appDownload.description: Set your locality and budget once. The app pings you when a matching owner listing goes live.
